product_metadata.title: White Classic Luxury Navy Blue Bath Towel Set - 600GSM 8 Piece | Navy Blue
features: WRAP YOURSELF IN BLISSFUL LUXURY - At the end of a long day, or at the start of a new one, you deserve a little luxury. Transform your home into a sanctuary and your bathroom into a mini spa with the help of White Classic deliciously soft, plush, comfy elegant navy blue towels.

THIS SET OF 8 HOTEL & SPA TOWELS - Two matching Bath towels (27 inch x 54 inch), Two hand towels (16 inch x 30 inch), and Four washcloths (13 inch x 13 inch) Elegant towels you find in Hotels and Spas, Soft, durable, lightweight, and highly absorbent navy blue towels. It is more absorbent then any Turkish Cotton Towels.

SUPER SOFT, LONG LASTING & CONVENIENT - Set of 8 bath hand face towels for bathroom comes with a choice of white, grey, black, navy blue, light blue, brown, burgundy, green, beige and pink. You can use them pretty much anywhere! Hang some in the bathroom, put some in your gym bag for when you work up a sweat, leave some in the high quality guest room for your visitors, This is also a perfect gift for your loved one - housewarming gift - holiday gift any occasion.

EASY CARE & FAST DRY - These wash towels are perfectly machine washable and dry very fast too. They become even plusher and softer fluff after the first wash, and cause no shrinkage, so enjoy the ease in which you can just throw a couple into the wash and enjoy them coming out fresh and clean.
WE’VE GOT YOU COVERED - Indulge in luxury that lasts with our White Classic complimentary 2-year extended warranty.
